policy.validation_contract: leakage-safe chronological validation against an unregularized baseline

cap_loto_50.definition: Partition 00..99 into 45 reverse pairs AB-BA plus five kep-bong pairs.

kep_bong.definition: Five double-number pairs completed by the full-number bong-duong relation.
kep_bong.statistical_policy: members may share pair-level evidence but probabilities must not be forced equal

bong_am.definition: Documented folklore involution used by common Vietnamese number tables.

bo_he.definition: 15 unique families generated by digit-wise bong-duong plus reverse: 10 bo-thuong of 8 numbers and five bo-kep of 4 numbers.

cham.definition: Cham d is the set of two-digit numbers containing digit d in either position; each cham has 19 unique members.

tong_mod10.definition: Tong d contains numbers with (head + tail) mod 10 = d; each tong has 10 members.

gan.definition: Number of consecutive completed draws since the number or group last appeared.
gan.implementation_rule: measure from completed canonical draws only; never interpret long absence as increased probability without validation

khan.definition: Low empirical frequency inside a specified rolling window; distinct from current consecutive absence (gan).

nong_hot.definition: High empirical frequency inside a specified recent rolling window.

cam_dau.definition: A digit absent from the tens/head position across all loto values in the specified draw or window.

cam_duoi.definition: A digit absent from the ones/tail position across all loto values in the specified draw or window.

hai_nhay.definition: A two-digit loto value occurring exactly twice in the same completed draw.

nhieu_nhay.definition: A two-digit loto value occurring at least N times in one draw.

roi.definition: A number repeats across consecutive completed draws; use an explicit lag rather than a narrative rule.

bet.definition: A consecutive-run state for an explicitly named property such as a number, bo, tong or cham.
bet.implementation_rule: never use the word bet without identifying the property and run definition

tong_thieu.definition: A tong group absent or underrepresented in an explicitly specified recent scope.

cham_thieu.definition: A cham group absent or underrepresented in an explicitly specified recent scope.

trung_cau.definition: Two or more independently defined path/rule generators produce overlapping candidate numbers.
trung_cau.implementation_rule: store generator IDs and overlap count; do not count near-duplicate rules as independent evidence

trung_bo.definition: Independent candidate generators map into the same canonical bo family.
trung_bo.implementation_rule: deduplicate by canonical bo_family_id before measuring agreement

nuoi_khung.definition: Evaluate a fixed candidate over an explicitly bounded sequence of future draws.
nuoi_khung.implementation_rule: report horizon hit rate and risk separately; never convert it into a guaranteed forecast

bac_nho.definition: Community umbrella term for conditional follow-on relationships from prior outcomes.
bac_nho.implementation_rule: represent each proposed relationship as a dated conditional rule and validate out of sample

sat_kep.definition: Adjacent-digit group; VLA must name linear vs circular variants explicitly.
sat_kep.implementation_rule: do not mix 09/90 circular adjacency into the linear definition
